products.name: Entra ID & Intune Audit Telemetry to Microsoft Sentinel — Commercial
products.short_description: Wire Entra ID and Intune audit telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel — diagnostic settings and connectors into Log Analytics, retention, and baseline analytics so identity and device activity is centralized, retained, and alert-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stream identity and device audit logs into Sentinel — so nothing happens unseen

Your identity and device platforms generate exactly the audit signal a SOC needs — sign-ins, directory changes, device compliance and enrollment events — but by default it's siloed in Entra ID and Intune, short-retained, and invisible to your SIEM. This solution wires Entra ID and Intune audit telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel: diagnostic settings and data connectors into Log Analytics, sensible retention, and baseline analytics so identity and endpoint activity is centralized, retained for compliance, and ready to alert on.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the telemetry pipeline (Entra ID and Intune diagnostic logs → Log Analytics workspace → Microsoft Sentinel), the relevant log categories (sign-in, audit, device/compliance), retention, and baseline analytics rules.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Azure subscription, a Log Analytics workspace, Microsoft Sentinel enabled, Entra ID and Intune diagnostic settings/connectors, retention/cost plan, RBAC) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the workspace and Sentinel, enable Entra ID diagnostic settings and the data connector, route Intune audit telemetry, set retention, enable baseline analytics rules, validate ingestion, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — telemetry-readiness discovery, ingestion/connector validation, a log-coverage and retention report, safe remediation of missing diagnostic settings, and a workspace/RBAC scoping helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Identity and device audit telemetry centralized in Microsoft Sentinel — retained for compliance and ready to alert on — so nothing in Entra ID or Intune happens unseen, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SENTLOG-Discovery.ps1 — telemetry-pipeline readiness for Entra ID & Intune audit logs into Sentinel
    • SENTLOG-Remediation.ps1 — add a missing Entra ID diagnostic setting routing audit logs to the workspace
    • SENTLOG-Report.ps1 — log-coverage and retention report for the audit-telemetry workspace
    • SENTLOG-Set-WorkspaceScopeTargeting.ps1 — report and apply scoped Microsoft Sentinel RBAC on the workspace
    • SENTLOG-Validation.ps1 — confirm Entra ID/Intune telemetry is actually being ingested into the workspace

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
